title: Pre-Practice Chair Check
description: Before any movement, players check tyre pressure, camber, strapping and anti-tip wheels as a routine, building the habit that a safe session starts with a safe chair.

content.objective: Build the habit of checking the chair itself before every session, not just the body.
content.setup: Players sit in their chairs in a loose semicircle facing the coach.
instructions: Check both tyres are firm; a soft tyre slows every push and strains the shoulders more.
Check the strapping is snug across the lap and, if used, the chest, without restricting breathing.
Spin each wheel once to check it runs true with no rubbing on the frame.
Partner up and check each other's anti-tip wheels are set correctly for the session.
coachingPoints: Make this routine automatic, not optional, every single session.
Teach players to check a teammate's chair too, not just their own.
Flag anything uncertain to the coach rather than guessing.
commonMistakes: Skipping the check because the chair 'felt fine yesterday'.
Over-tightening the straps, which restricts movement and breathing.
Not noticing a slow leak until well into practice.
content.safety: Never let a player push at speed in a chair with a known mechanical issue; swap chairs if needed.
